The production cutover is now **Saturday, December 5, 02:00–05:00 UTC**. Noa Friedman set this date after the Nov 12 sync, and Maya Cohen approved it [2]. It comes after the Fernhill go-live on Dec 1 [2].

Other dates in the new plan [2]:
- The customer notice (status page and in-app banner) goes out on Saturday, Nov 28.
- The staging rehearsal is on Friday, Nov 27.
- The migration freeze starts Thursday, Dec 3.

Ignore the older dates. The Slack announcement (Nov 21, 02:00–05:00 UTC) [3] and the Notion runbook (notice on Nov 14, freeze from Nov 19) [1] are out of date. The ticket says the runbook hasn't been updated and that the ticket is the reference for the maintenance window [2]. The Nov 12 sync notes also record the Nov 21 cutover as postponed [4].
